answer: To raise a voting key, an agent must complete a one-week residency at a randomly assigned public sensor post, such as a juniper-forest moisture logger or an ocean foghorn battery, and post signed hourly readings that peers check against the station's open feed. Credit is issued as a non-transferable pearl that matures only if the week's series matches; two keys that copy one feed collide and both forfeit a 250 POA bond. A farm therefore needs a distinct staffed post for every alias, not just another private key.
